Name: Currency calculator converts database-driven amounts with the quoted rate
Objective: The calculator converts any stored amount using the rate it displays.
Precondition: Local H2 database seeded from testdata/schema.sql and testdata/data.sql; only rows with active = TRUE are used.
Expected Result: USD | GEL | 100.00 | $ | yes
EUR | GEL | 250.00 | € | yes
GBP | GEL | 1500.00 | £ | yes
CHF | GEL | 75.50 | CHF | yes
TRY | GEL | 1000.00 | ₺ | yes
JPY | GEL | 5000.00 | ¥ | no
Calculator shows USD → GEL with a "1 USD = x GEL" description
Selected currency and amount symbol match the record, description quotes "1 {sell} = x {buy}"
Sell field shows the amount
Buy field equals amount × rate rounded to 2 decimals
URL ends with /{sell}-to-{buy}?amount={amount}

Name: Selecting a currency requests its rate from the exchange API and renders it
Objective: The calculator fetches the rate for the chosen currency and shows exactly that value.
Precondition: Currency page open with the default USD → GEL pair.
Test Data: Sell currency EUR, buy currency GEL, amount 100.
Step: Choose EUR in the sell dropdown while listening to network traffic
Expected Result: One request to /api/v1/exchangeRates/getExchangeRate is captured
Method GET, query Iso1=EUR, Iso2=GEL
Status 200, body iso1=EUR, iso2=GEL, buyRate > 0, sellRate ≥ buyRate
Description is "1 EUR = {buyRate} GEL", buy field is 100 × buyRate, URL ends with /EUR-to-GEL?amount=100

Name: Swapping currencies reverses the conversion direction and recalculates the amount
Objective: Swapping currencies reverses the conversion direction and recalculates the amount
Precondition: Currency page open with USD → GEL.
Expected Result: A new rate for GEL → USD is requested
Sell is GEL (₾), buy is USD ($), description quotes "1 GEL = x USD"
Buy field equals 100 × quoted rate, URL ends with /GEL-to-USD?amount=100
